brushPacks/dry_media.description: Sticks and powders that catch on the paper's tooth.

brushes/pencil.description: A graphite tip over paper grain. A pass lays down what the pressure allows and no more: going back over a mark at the same pressure adds nothing, pressing harder does.

brushes/charcoal.description: A soft stick that crumbles onto the tooth of the paper, for broad, smoky marks.

brushes/hair.description: A lock of individual strands with optional twirling

brushes/sponge.description: A textured brush useful for laying down big, smooth shapes
